name: Columbus City Schools
calendarType: Traditional calendar for most schools, a July-start year-round calendar for Woodcrest Elementary, and separate Pre-K calendars for both tracks
seoTitle: Columbus City Schools Calendar: CCS Dates & Tracks
seoDescription: Reviewed CCS traditional, Woodcrest year-round, and Pre-K calendars with staggered first days, intersessions, Wellness Week, early dismissal, and PDFs.
districtFact: CCS does not operate on one universal calendar: most students follow the traditional schedule, Woodcrest Elementary starts in July and uses intersessions, and Pre-K families receive separate track-specific calendars with orientation and family-engagement dates.

about.title: Three Calendars Sit Under One CCS Calendar Hub
about.content: The district publishes traditional, Woodcrest year-round, and Pre-K calendars side by side. The default dates on this site follow the traditional grades 1-12 calendar; Woodcrest and Pre-K PDFs remain separate because their first days and attendance interruptions differ.

about.title: Woodcrest Starts Nearly a Month Earlier
about.content: Woodcrest Elementary is the district's year-round school. Grades 1-5 begin in July, kindergarten and Pre-K join five days later, and fall, January, and spring intersessions replace the traditional calendar's long uninterrupted terms.

about.title: The Traditional Opening Is Staggered by Program
about.content: Grades 1-12 begin first, kindergarten begins the following Tuesday, and traditional Pre-K begins after Labor Day. A single label such as “first day of school” is therefore incomplete unless it also names the grade or program.

about.title: Pre-K Has Its Own Attendance and Family Calendar
about.content: CCS publishes one Pre-K calendar for traditional sites and another for Woodcrest. They add no-Pre-K professional-development days, orientation details, F.A.C.E. meetings, webinars, and family events that do not belong on a general K-12 download.

about.title: Wellness Week Is More Than Thanksgiving Day
about.content: Both main tracks close for the full Monday-through-Friday Wellness Week in November. The Wednesday inside that closure is identified as the compensatory day for parent conferences, so families should plan for five weekdays without classes rather than a shorter holiday break.

about.title: CCS Serves a Multilingual Capital-City Community
about.content: The district profile reports about 45,000 students in 110 schools. Families in roughly 30,000 student households speak 95 languages and come from 104 countries, with Spanish, Somali, Nepali, Arabic, and French listed as the leading non-English home languages.

calendarNotes: The CCS default calendar applies to traditional schools, not Woodcrest Elementary's July-start year-round schedule. Grades 1-12, kindergarten, and Pre-K do not share one first day. A 30-minute early dismissal on the traditional calendar does not apply to Pre-K when that same date is marked as a no-Pre-K professional-development day. Woodcrest intersessions are separate attendance breaks and should not be copied onto a traditional-school calendar. Wellness Week closes schools for five weekdays, with the Wednesday designated as the compensatory day for parent conferences. Records and professional-development days marked “students not in attendance” are treated as student closures. Families should still use the live district and individual school calendars for activities, transportation notices, and emergency revisions.

planningTips.title: Planning with CCS's Three Calendar Tracks
content: Confirm whether the student follows the traditional calendar, Woodcrest year-round calendar, or a Pre-K version before saving dates.
Use the grade label on the August opening: grades 1-12 begin before kindergarten, and traditional Pre-K begins after Labor Day.
Reserve all five weekdays of November Wellness Week; the conference compensatory day sits inside that closure.
Do not treat Woodcrest intersession as a districtwide break or assume traditional Spring Break covers the full Woodcrest pause.
On 30-minute early-dismissal dates, Pre-K is closed for professional development instead of dismissing 30 minutes early.
Pre-K families should retain the dedicated PDF for orientation, no-Pre-K days, F.A.C.E. meetings, webinars, and family events.
Check the CCS live calendar and the student's school calendar after weather or other public-calamity closures because the PDFs are subject to revision.

districtFaqs.q: Does every Columbus City Schools student follow the traditional calendar?
districtFaqs.a: No. Most schools use the traditional calendar, while Woodcrest Elementary uses a year-round calendar with a July start and intersessions. Pre-K has separate traditional and Woodcrest calendars.

districtFaqs.q: Do all CCS students start school on the same day?
districtFaqs.a: No. The traditional calendar starts grades 1-12 first, kindergarten five days later, and Pre-K after Labor Day. Woodcrest grades 1-5 start in July, followed five days later by Woodcrest kindergarten and Pre-K.

districtFaqs.q: What is Wellness Week in Columbus City Schools?
districtFaqs.a: Wellness Week is a Monday-through-Friday closure during Thanksgiving week. Its Wednesday is also the compensatory day for parent conferences.

districtFaqs.q: Is the 30-minute early dismissal also an early dismissal for Pre-K?
districtFaqs.a: No. The traditional K-12 calendar marks a 30-minute early dismissal, while the Pre-K calendar marks the same date as no Pre-K for professional development.

districtFaqs.q: What is an intersession on the Woodcrest calendar?
districtFaqs.a: An intersession is a break in Woodcrest's year-round attendance cycle. It is not a districtwide closure and should not be added to a traditional-school calendar.

districtFaqs.q: Does the CCS calendar hub always match the PDF wording?
districtFaqs.a: Not always. For 2026-27, the hub summary conflicts with the official PDF on the August grade scope and Quarter 2 end date. This site uses the PDF and discloses the mismatch on the 2026-27 page.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families check CCS school events and weather changes?
districtFaqs.a: Use the live district calendar and the student's individual school calendar. The printable PDFs state that dates may be revised after severe weather, energy problems, or another public calamity.

customSections.label: Choose the CCS Calendar Before You Save a Date
customSections.content: CCS publishes three practical calendar layers. The traditional calendar is the districtwide baseline, but it is not a safe substitute for Woodcrest or Pre-K.
